I purchased an Omron HEM-7090-L blood pressure monitor from Blinkit. Unfortunately, I found the cuff design to be uncomfortable and difficult to use correctly. In my experience, it did not fit well enough for me to feel confident while taking blood pressure measurements. I contacted Blinkit within 72 hours of receiving the product and explained that the monitor was not suitable for me because of the cuff design. However, I was informed that the item was replacement-only and my request for a return was declined. I also requested a one-time exception, but this was not considered. I understand that policies exist, but I was disappointed that there was no flexibility for a medical device that I genuinely could not use comfortably. I hope Blinkit considers handling such situations with greater customer empathy in the future, especially when the request is made promptly after delivery.

If something goes wrong with your order, dont expect reliable customer support. I cannot recommend this app because of its poor replacement policy and disappointing customer service. I ordered rice through Blinkit and received a product that was of poor quality. After raising a complaint, Blinkit approved the return and refund request and arranged for the product to be picked up. The item was collected successfully. However, after the pickup was completed, the experience became frustrating. It was extremely difficult to get clear updates regarding the refund and return status. The available support options were limited, and I felt that there was no effective way to reach the company for a proper resolution. As a customer, I expect a company to provide transparent communication and reliable support, especially after collecting a returned product. Instead, I was left uncertain about the status of my refund and had to spend additional time following up on the issue. Based on my experience, Blinkit's post-return customer support and grievance handling process need significant improvement. Customers should not have to struggle to get updates after a return pickup has been completed. I hope Blinkit addresses these issues and improves its customer service standards.

Exceptional delivery support, but the app and refund policy are a nightmare. I am writing this review to highlight a massive discrepancy between this companys service and its technology. On one hand, I had a fantastic experience with the delivery personnel. He was professional, helpful, and actually went out of his way to assist me with the refund process when he saw I was struggling. If the rating were based solely on him, it would be five stars. However, the app itself and the corporate refund service are abysmal. The interface is not user-friendly, and despite the "refund service" being advertised, it is nearly impossible to navigate or execute through the official channels. It shouldn't require the manual intervention of a delivery driver to fix a systemic failure in your app. The backend service needs a complete overhaul to match the competence of the people you have on the ground. Until the refund process is streamlined and the app bugs are fixed, I cannot recommend using this service.

I have been using Blinkit for quick grocery deliveries for the past few months, and my experience has been mixed. The biggest advantage is definitely the fast delivery. In many cases, my order arrived within 10 minutes, which is very helpful during emergencies or when you forget to buy essential items like milk or bread. The app interface is also simple and easy to navigate, making the ordering process smooth. However, there have been some disappointing experiences as well. A few times, items were shown as available but got cancelled after placing the order. I also received vegetables that were not very fresh. Customer support is mostly chat-based, and resolving issues can take time. Refunds are not always instant, which can be frustrating. Pricing is slightly higher compared to local stores, but you are paying for convenience and speed. Overall, Blinkit is good for urgent and small orders, but I would not rely on it for full monthly grocery shopping. Its convenient, but consistency and quality control need improvement.
